# LinkedIn Profile Search Scraper (No Cookies) Find all people

The Apify actor [`harvestapi/linkedin-profile-search`](https://apify.com/harvestapi/linkedin-profile-search) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.0.281**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

Search for LinkedIn profiles with filters and extract detailed profile information, including work experience, education history, location, and more. No cookies or account required.

## Pricing

Pay per event — Search page results $0.1, Full profile $0.004, Full profile + email search $0.01 (Free-plan prices; paid plans pay less). Cap the spend with `maxTotalChargeUsd`.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/harvestapi/linkedin-profile-search) for current prices.

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/harvestapi-linkedin-profile-search@0.0.281#sha256-…
```

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs: {}
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.
